packageRules.description: Non-major cargo updates in one grouped PR instead of one PR per crate.
dtolnay/rust-toolchain versions by BRANCH (1.97.1), not tag — the github-actions manager can't track it. The custom manager below tracks the @<ver> ref as a Rust release instead.
Keep every Rust-version pin in lockstep, in ONE PR: rust-toolchain.toml, the MSRV in Cargo.toml and the dtolnay/rust-toolchain CI action are all surfaced as depName 'rust'.

customManagers.description: rust-toolchain.toml channel: the toolchain for build, lint and format. Tracked as a Rust release (rust-lang/rust) under depName 'rust'; no built-in manager parses rust-toolchain.toml.
dtolnay/rust-toolchain CI action ref — tracked as a Rust release under depName 'rust' so it bumps WITH the toolchain.
Cargo.toml MSRV (rust-version) — in lockstep with the toolchain under depName 'rust' (major.minor, via the rust Docker tags).
